verdict.rationale: Vestd has a shareholder-dashboards page inviting the team onto the platform, and option recipients submit exercise requests through Vestd themselves. Together these imply that employees get their own platform access, but the evidence is a single thin mention and an indirect workflow reference. missing for 10: documented display of grants, vesting progress and strike price in the employee view, outcome/exit scenario modeling of equity value, any detailed docs or independent corroboration of the employee portal.
